# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_policy (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  role_name   = "read-only"

  trusted_users = ["app-backend"]
}

# The role's inline policy is what the role may do once assumed - distinct from
# its trusted_users, which is who may assume it.
resource "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_policy" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  role_name   = fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role.example.role_name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["s3:GetObject"]
        Resource = ["arn:aws:s3:::your_bucket_name/*"]
      },
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) The inline policy document in JSON format. Every resource it names must be a bucket this account owns - the API rejects a policy that reaches outside it
- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role the policy is attached to
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policy_name` (String) The name the platform stores the inline policy under
